signature.prompt: Point to every curb ramp in this street-level image. A curb ramp (curb cut) is the short sloped ramp cut into a sidewalk curb at a street corner or crossing that lets a wheelchair or stroller roll from sidewalk to street. Put one point at the center of each curb ramp. Do not point at driveways, stairs, or crosswalk paint. If there are no curb ramps, say so.
